page.overview:
Who is Desolous?

Desolous was a Sith Lord who was active in the galaxy long before The Sith Eternal cult, which was active during that time, had a custom of naming their Sith trooper detachments after ancient Sith. The Desolous Legion was thus named after them—a name whose true significance remained a mystery to those outside of the cult.

Desolous was first mentioned in the current Star Wars canon in Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary,

The character originated in the Star Wars Legends continuity, where he was depicted as a Pau'an Sith Lord named Darth Desolous, and was created as an exclusive character for the PlayStation 2, PlayStation Portable and Wii versions of the 2008 video game Star Wars: The Force Unleashed, developed by Krome Studios and published by LucasArts.

Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary
